utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Gus, I’ve only heard second-hand that Saturday 9 to noon by the mailboxes is the repair window, and Oren thought it might just be sign-ups for now. I’d check with Cleo, Mara, or Uli before treating that as official.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell—I’ll treat that as unconfirmed and check with Cleo, Mara, or Uli before I tell anyone a firm time or spot. For now I’m just staging the tools and request sheets so we’re ready either way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds wise, Gus—having things ready without announcing anything firm seems safest. If I hear a confirmed collection spot or sign-up plan from Cleo, Mara, or Uli, I’ll pass it along as clearly marked.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks again, Rosa—I’ve got it straight now: Sunday at the community center, and I’ll make sure folks know you still need volunteers, tools, and repair requests.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Tess—that’s exactly the message. If anyone asks for specifics on tools or items, tell them I’m checking with Opal and will send an update as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it, Rosa—I’ll stick to the confirmed basics for now, and if anyone asks for tool specifics I’ll tell them you’re checking with Opal and an update’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Cleo—Saturday morning we’re doing the repair work and sign-ups by the laundry room. Mara and Rosa have the tool-kit list, so I’m trying not to add extra confusion.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli—that helps. I’ll check with Mara and Rosa before updating the supply list, and I’ll note the laundry room as the sign-up spot for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. I’m a bit stretched this week, so keeping it simple and pointing folks to Mara and Rosa is a real help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Jules, before we tell more people, can we pin down whether it’s the community room or by the mailboxes, and who’s officially taking sign-ups?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: You’re right, Pia — let’s not widen the word yet until I confirm the location and sign-up lead with Opal or Rey. I’ll ask for those two specifics and circle back as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’ll hold off on mentioning it to anyone else until you hear back. If you can also ask who’s bringing extension cords, that would save us a scramble.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mina, I’m catching up on the repair drive now—I’m confirming manager approval for the table area and the laundry-room setup today, then I’ll pass Sam the clean details for your list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please tell me the exact approved table spot, laundry-room setup, and timing as soon as you have it, and let Sam know I still need the confirmed repair list and helper names before I can assign anyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do—I’ll get you the exact spot, setup, and timing as soon as the manager confirms, and I’ll nudge Sam for the repair list and helper names before anything gets assigned.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Oren, we’re aiming for Saturday 9 to noon, starting with bikes and small appliances. I’m finalizing the sign-up list around school pickup schedules this afternoon—are you looking to help, or bring something by?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks Faye—Saturday 9 to noon, bikes and small appliances first, got it. I can help with sign-ups by the laundry room, and I won’t tell folks to bring tools unless Mara or Rosa says so.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren—that would be a big help. I’ll put you down for sign-ups by the laundry room and confirm the final list this afternoon before we spread anything wider.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Bo. We’re planning on Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon, at the community room by the park, but I’m waiting on Sam’s final accepted-items and volunteer list before we announce it broadly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Morning Eli—got it, I won’t spread it broadly yet. I’ll just tell folks to wait for Sam’s final list before assuming what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thank you, Bo. Once Sam sends the clean list, I’ll make sure you have the exact wording so everyone hears the same thing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Ira, I’m waiting on Faye’s confirmed list before I pass anything along—right now bikes and small appliances seem likely, but I don’t want to treat that as final yet.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds right, Hana—hold off on calling it final until Faye confirms. I’m still trying to pin down the time and place too, but I’ll keep telling folks the big thing is to sign up ahead with what they’re bringing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira—that helps. I’ll tell people only to sign up ahead with what they’re bringing, and I’ll keep the repair scope, time, and place marked pending until Faye or you confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Leo, the clearest thing I have so far is that Saturday is sign-ups only—no tool drop-offs yet—and folks should list what they’re bringing, especially small appliances, chairs, or bikes, while Ira pins down the exact time and place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal. I’ll pass along sign-ups only for now and hold off on tool drop-offs until Ira confirms the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Leo—please also tell people to note any special tool needs on the sheet, and I’ll update you as soon as Ira confirms the exact location and time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, Quinn — I’ll keep it quiet for now and won’t loop Tess in until you’ve confirmed the table layout and sign-up lead.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey—I appreciate you keeping it contained. I’ll nudge Eli about the layout and sign-up lead, then circle back to you before anything goes to Tess.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Quinn — I’ll wait for your word and keep Mrs. Alvarez’s screen door on the separate home-repair list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, I’m telling folks we’re gathering repair needs and volunteers for the repair drive, but the time and drop-off spot aren’t confirmed yet. If Rosa or Hana sends the final details, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — for now please tell folks it’s Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon, at the community room by the park, and that Saturday is just for sign-ups and confirming accepted items. I’m still locking down the repair list and helper names for Mina today.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Sam — I’ll share Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon at the community room by the park, and make clear it’s just for sign-ups and confirming accepted items for now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Kira—sorry, I’m a bit scattered, but I think we’re still gathering repair needs and volunteers until Rosa or the organizers confirm the final time and drop-off spot. Did you hear anything newer?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Nothing newer from me, Noah—I’m still waiting for confirmation on who’s officially organizing it, the final time and drop-off spot, and exactly which repair categories are covered before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks Kira—I won’t spread the Saturday/laundry-room thing like it’s confirmed, then. I’ll check with Rosa or whoever’s organizing and let you know once I hear something solid.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rey, I’m updating the repair drive supply list for Saturday morning—do you know if you’re bringing any tools, spare parts, duct tape, or batteries?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring duct tape and a small screwdriver set, but I’m only there the first hour. I won’t say anything about the mailbox spot until you or Mara confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—I’ll mark you down for duct tape and a small screwdriver set for the first hour. I’ll hold off on mentioning any drop-off spot until Mara or I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, quick update: I still don’t have confirmed organizer or repair-category details from Opal or Rey, so let’s keep holding off on outreach until that’s solid.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Jules—I’ll hold off and won’t point folks to sign up yet until Opal or Rey confirms the organizer and categories.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo—that’s perfect. I’ll keep you in the loop as soon as I hear anything solid, and then we can pull in Tess, Vik, and whoever else makes sense.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rosa, Mara asked me to check on Leo and Noah for a short intake shift; Leo can spare an hour Saturday morning, but I still need to catch Noah.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli—small update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, so could you ask Leo if he can switch that hour and keep trying Noah?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Okay, thanks for telling me. I’ll ask Leo if Sunday at the community center still works for his hour, and I’ll keep trying Noah quietly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Quinn, thanks for holding off—I'm just finishing the school pickup check-ins now and will send the confirmed sign-up list this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Faye — I’ll keep it quiet until your list lands, then I’ll send invites with the confirmed Saturday 9 to noon details and bikes/small appliances first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Quinn — I should have it to you after pickup, and I’ll flag who’s covering bikes versus appliances so your invite is clear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hana, before we spread the word, have you heard whether the manager approved the table area? Dane may handle sign-ups, but I don’t want us announcing details that aren’t settled.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t heard confirmed approval for the table area yet, so I wouldn’t announce that part. I’ll keep Dane on sign-ups as tentative too until Faye sends the confirmed details this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — I’ll hold off on posting anything until Faye confirms, and maybe we should mention only that details are pending if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Ira, I’m still piecing it together second-hand, but I’ve heard Saturday 9 to noon by the mailboxes may be the repair window or sign-ups. I’d check with Mara, Uli, or Cleo before treating that as official.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Nell — I’ll treat Saturday 9 to noon by the mailboxes as tentative and check with Mara, Uli, or Cleo before I pass it around as official.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds safest, thanks Ira. If you hear anything firm back, would you let me know too so I don’t keep repeating half-news?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Tess, yes—the repair drive is Saturday morning by the laundry room, with repair work and sign-ups there. I’m leaving the tool-kit list to Mara and Rosa so I don’t confuse everyone again.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oren, quick update so we don’t cross wires: Rosa confirmed it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday by the laundry room. They’re still collecting volunteers, tools, and repair needs, so please pass that version along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh dear, thank you, Tess—I had the old version stuck in my head again. I’ll tell folks it’s Sunday at the community center, and that volunteers, tools, and repair needs are all being collected.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks again, Leo—please plan on Saturday morning intake, and I’ll circle back with the exact slot once Rosa confirms it. For now, just remember it’s sign-ups only, so no tools or repair items need to come in yet.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—Saturday morning intake only, no tools or items. I’ll track names, contact info, repair item, and carry-in needs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks Leo—that’s exactly it. I’ll message you as soon as Rosa pins down the morning slot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Opal, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive, but I’m only sharing confirmed bits for now: we’re gathering repair needs and volunteers, and I’m waiting on the final time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Vik — that matches what I’ve got: sign-ups first, with folks listing items ahead, and no tool drop-off yet. Please tell people I’m tracking item type, location, transport needs, and any special tools, but I’ll wait on Ira or Mara before naming a time or place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Opal—I’ll tell folks to sign up with item type, location, transport needs, and any special tools, and I won’t mention any time, place, or tool drop-off until Ira or Mara confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Kira—right now I’m pinning down the accepted repair items and helper names, and this Saturday is just for sign-ups, not tool drop-off. If you know anyone lending tools or volunteering, send me their name today so I can get Mina the clean list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam — before I send any names, can you confirm whether Opal has officially approved who’s organizing it and exactly which repair categories are accepted?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not fully yet—I’m treating Eli’s Saturday plan as the working setup, but I still need Opal’s official okay on organizers and the final accepted categories before I call it settled. I’ll check with Opal now and only fold in names once that’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Gus. The plan is Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon, at the community room by the park, and I’m waiting on Sam’s clean accepted-items and volunteer list before we ask folks to spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Morning, Eli—sounds good; I’ll hold off on blasting it around until Sam’s list is clean. I’ve got the bike stand, basic wrenches, small appliance tester, and a drill set aside for now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s perfect, Gus, thank you — keep those set aside, and once Sam gives me the final list, I’ll make sure your tools match what we’re actually accepting.
